snippet.title: Voldark - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Voldark is an open-world survival crafting game set in a dangerous forest filled with mutant creatures. Gather resources, craft tools and weapons, level up your character, build and defend your base while surviving relentless nighttime attacks.

Steam link in bio.
